ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity white regions occupy the lateral lobes. A central low-intensity black region extends towards the lobe tips. Small, discrete low-intensity circular spots are scattered within the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with an angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated profile along the trailing edge boundary with frequent pixel-level peaks and valleys, particularly on the distal portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch to the distal tips along the superior trailing edge boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, roughly circular pixel clusters (3-8 pixels in diameter) distributed across the white distal portions of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, nearly parallel, low-intensity linear marks visible on the white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of distinct rake marks on the left lobe and extensive irregular dark pigmentation patterns at the fluke base.
